name: blob-solutions/woocommerce-vcr-am-strauss-bin
description: Isolated composer-bin context for brianhenryie/strauss. Strauss's transitive deps (voku/simple-cache -> psr/simple-cache 1|2) conflict with Pest 4's mutate plugin (psr/simple-cache 3) when installed in the main require-dev. Keeping Strauss here lets us scope production deps for WP.org distribution without dragging that conflict into the main composer environment. Held below 0.29 for one reason: 0.29 rewrote string handling onto php-parser (fixing upstream #112, where any string matching an imported class name was rewritten), and the new define()/defined() handler matches the whole string against the global-constant map. 'GuzzleHttp\\ClientInterface::MAJOR_VERSION' is a CLASS constant, so it matches nothing and the class name in front of the :: is left unprefixed. That expression is how php-http/discovery detects Guzzle as a PSR-18 client (CommonClassesStrategy::isGuzzleImplementingPsr18). Verified by building on both: 0.28.1 emits the prefixed constant, 0.30.0 the unprefixed one. Latent for us today because VcrClientFactory always passes an explicit client. 0.30's exclude_from_string_rename only excludes more, so there is no config that buys the old behaviour back.
